# Cameron Cogan

Cameron Cogan is an International Business Administration student experienced in marketing, SEO, AEO, web development, and international communication. He is multilingual with high grades in languages stemming back to Secondary School, where he received the grades 9 Distinction in IGCSE French & German.

## Profile

Cameron Cogan combines business strategy, digital expertise, and technical website development. His work focuses on creating optimised digital experiences, improving online visibility, and supporting organisations with multilingual communication. His knowledge of mathematics enables quality analysis of data and his academic performance highlights indicates promise in analytics. For instance he had a mid-term grade of 20/20 in quantitative methods & statistics and 17/20 for the final exam.
